Configure logrotate with postrotate script
output:
cat > /etc/logrotate.d/custom << 'EOF'
/var/log/myapp/*.log {
  weekly
  rotate 4
  compress
  delaycompress
  missingok
  notifempty
  sharedscripts
  postrotate
    systemctl reload myapp > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
  endscript
}
EOF

instruction: Create a udev rule to symlink a device by serial
output: echo 'SUBSYSTEM=="block", ATTRS{serial}=="ABC123", SYMLINK+="mydisk"' > /etc/udev/rules.d/99-disk.rules && udevadm control --reload-rules && udevadm trigger
